newsitem.title: USA: New York Times ups qtly class A, B divs.
newsitem.headline: New York Times ups qtly class A, B divs.

text.p: New York Times Company said on Friday it raised the quarterly dividend on its class A and class B common stock by $0.01 per share to $0.15 per share and $0.16 per share respectively.
The dividends are payable June 20 to shareholders of record on June 3.
This is the second dividend increase in the past six months.
The New York Times Co is a diversified media company including newspapers, magazines, television and radio stations, electronic information and publishing.
